asymmetric_workload.inference: Associational but prospectively correctable resource asymmetry; it cannot change H6 FAIL.

decision.rationale: H6 did not answer the KL method question. Its only early-stop trigger reduced completed update work, while both collection and PPO wall time nearly doubled and a CPU evaluator existed only beside treatment. The smallest valid repair is a new prospective A/B with fresh same-start control and treatment under identical no-evaluation trainer conditions, followed by frozen endpoint measurements.
requirements: H6 remains terminal and is never extended or reclassified.
Fresh H7 control and treatment each run fixed20M from exact gate31400 with identical current code and resource contract.
No mirror, holdout inference, Path-1 QA expansion, or other evaluator may start while either H7 trainer arm is active.
All endpoint evaluations start only after both exact endpoints are frozen.
One behavior variable remains ppo_target_kl0 versus0.03; thresholds are frozen before launch.
First60 and full-window throughput compare only contemporaneous H7 arms.

route_exhaustion_reason: KL method effect is unmeasured and multiple other HYBRID families remain available.
